tasks.title: HANGS Construction Services · Q3 2026 Form 941
tasks.description: Prepare the Q3 2026 Form 941 and Schedule B for HANGS Construction Services from 9 Excel, PDF, Word and email documents. Work out wages, withholding, Social Security and Medicare payday by payday, and check each deposit. Produce formula-linked Excel workpapers and supported figures on an incomplete draft return. Open items stay open for a person. This demo plays back one recorded run; the run’s real working time is shown at the end.
tasks.outputs: Two files: formula-linked Excel workpapers with evidence tabs, and an incomplete draft Form 941 PDF with evidence trails and original source attachments
tasks.gates: Incomplete draft, not reviewed, signed or filed. Missing evidence and differences stay open. A person reviews and files.
tasks.periodLine: Q3 2026: July 1–September 30, 2026 · Form 941 and Schedule B · due November 2, 2026, or November 10 when every deposit was made on time.
